# Productivity Maxing

> Free, open-source task and grade tracker for academic life. Organize
> coursework into Areas, track deadlines and difficulty, compare target vs
> real grades, and optionally sync deadlines to Google Calendar.

Productivity Maxing is a single-developer web app (React/TypeScript frontend,
NestJS/Prisma/PostgreSQL backend) for students. It is not a general-purpose
task manager - it's built specifically around academic workflows: courses
("Areas"), graded work with weight/difficulty, target-vs-real grade tracking,
and study-session/focus logging.

## Pages

- [Home](https://app.pmaxing.pt/): product overview and sign-up entry point.
- [Register](https://app.pmaxing.pt/register): create a free account.
- [Login](https://app.pmaxing.pt/login): sign in (email/password, Google, GitHub, or Discord).
- [Privacy Policy](https://app.pmaxing.pt/privacy): what data is collected and why.
- [Terms of Service](https://app.pmaxing.pt/terms): usage terms for the hosted app.
- [EULA](https://app.pmaxing.pt/eula): license terms for the downloadable Windows companion agent.
- [DMCA Policy](https://app.pmaxing.pt/dmca): copyright notice-and-takedown process.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Rodrigo-Esteves13/Productivity_Maxing) - MIT licensed, open source.

## Notes for automated agents

Everything past the homepage and auth pages requires a logged-in session -
there is no public content to crawl or summarize beyond what's listed above.
